explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/617: Erdős and Gyárfás 'showed this property fails for infinitely many r if we replace r²+1 by r²'. The Lean statement: the set of r for which there is a vertex set of size r² and an r-colouring of pairs such that every (r+1)-set of vertices sees every colour on some pair of distinct vertices (a balanced colouring) is infinite. The degenerate members r = 0, 1 (vacuous) do not affect infinitude. Faithful.
